justification: Changes which live-data checks run in PR and main gates; the checks themselves and the nightly job are unchanged. Probe timeout handling is left to PR #1495, which changes the same files.

pre_impl.existing_data: Traced 2026-10-25: 12 gates.yml steps read live systems; 9 report live data state. PRs that week were blocked by DQ-79, DQ-118 x2, DQ-103/104/105 (timeouts: with a longer limit DQ-104 = 0, DQ-105 = 0) and data-watch freshness; none of those PRs changed that data.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Live-data steps in a PR read data the PR has not changed yet, so they cannot see the PR's effect; a timeout was reported as a regression.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One helper sets RUN_<KEY> per step; data-watch freshness moves from the PR gate to the daily outside alarm.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a PR touching no live-data file runs a live check, a PR editing the ledger skips it, wiring changes skip anything, or a DB timeout reads as red
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Tests on the real file lists of PRs #1494 and #1472; first timeout test failed under the psycopg2 stub, fixed by matching class names.

functions.name: decide
functions.input: the list of changed file paths, or None when unreadable
functions.output: for each live-data gate step whether it must run
functions.if_none: an unreadable diff runs every live check

functions.name: changed_files
functions.input: the push's previous commit, or nothing for a pull request
functions.output: files changed since that commit, or in HEAD~1..HEAD
functions.if_none: git failing or a new-branch all-zero commit returns None so everything runs

break_it.scenario: A PR marks a DQ row fixed while its check still fails
break_it.what_happens: would merge a false claim if the ledger did not run
break_it.how: editing dq_checks.json or the tracker runs the ledger in that PR

break_it.scenario: Someone edits gates.yml or the helper to switch a check off
break_it.what_happens: a live-data check silently stops running in gates
break_it.how: a change to either file runs every live check

break_it.scenario: The nightly data-watch job stops running
break_it.what_happens: live data unwatched and no PR asks any more
break_it.how: freshness-alarm.yml checks it daily, sends red to Telegram and pings healthchecks.io

post_merge.manual_verify: Next PR touching no ledger file shows the live-data steps skipped; freshness-alarm run shows a datawatch rc.
